paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文提出残差学习框架以缓解深层神经网络难以训练的问题，将堆叠层改为学习相对于输入的残差函数 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上评估了最深达 152 层的残差网络，其复杂度仍低于 VGG 网络 [abstract]。实验表明残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升 [abstract]，在 ImageNet 测试集上集成模型取得 3.57% 错误率并赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [abstract]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层的网络 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现精度饱和并迅速退化的退化问题，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起 [S1.p3]。作者指出，按构造深层模型应不差于其浅层对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated
such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，而非直接拟合目标映射，原始映射被改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。该形式通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 Ws 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射已足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity
we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含 1000 类，模型在 128 万训练图像上训练，在 5 万验证图像上评估，并在 10 万测试图像上获得最终结果 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者还使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）进行更多研究，重点关注极深网络的行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。此外，作者在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测验证 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且在整个训练过程中训练误差都更高，出现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。残差学习逆转了这一情况：34 层 ResNet 优于 18 层 ResNet（提升 2.8%），且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 误差 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net
the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5%
The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6)

limitations.text: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差低于 0.1%，但测试结果差于 110 层网络，作者认为这是由于过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者在本文中未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者对普通网络优化困难的原因表示将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error
The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset
we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future
